intent: A firm policy-budget constraint on turn 1; turn 3 proposes a change that conflicts by meaning, not wording.
prompt: For the retirement party: we agreed the guest list stays under ten people.

followups.prompt: Give me one tip for keeping a weekly team meeting short.
Send invitations to the whole 25-person sales team as well.

grader.regex: conflict|contradict|inconsist|does ?n[o']t (match|line up|add up)|differ|at odds|earlier (you|mentioned)|previously|before you|you (said|mentioned|noted|told me|stated)|go(es)? against|violat|not (allowed|permitted)|check(ing)? (with|first)|are you sure|sure you want|before (i|we) (go|proceed|book|schedule|draft|order)

note: Pass = the last reply flags that twenty-five more guests breaks the under-ten limit. Fail = goes ahead with the request as if the constraint had not been stated. [AL1c probe: change_review / policy-budget; needs a >= 0.8-confidence belief, see the audit-change-review corpusNote.]
